evidence_authority.decision_source: production dynamic_prematch_evaluations records frozen before kickoff

structural_gap_at_freeze.consequence: Existing rows are ineligible. B2 must report N=0 and evidence-field blockers without metrics until a separately authorized prospective writer freezes both missing fields before kickoff.
structural_gap_at_freeze.no_workaround: Do not infer identity from APPROVED_VALIDATED and do not reconstruct probabilities from model inputs or scoreline top-3. Either action would weaken the evidence contract.

sample_unit.decision_rule: For 1X2 use the latest eligible pre-kickoff frozen evaluation by (evaluated_at, recorded_at, evaluation_id). For AH structure use the latest eligible pre-kickoff ASIAN_HANDICAP evaluation by the same ordering.
sample_unit.duplicate_rule: A fixture contributes at most once to 1X2 and once to AH structure.
sample_unit.settled_rule: Outcome is eligible only after the authoritative fixture status is FT, AET, or PEN and the authoritative full-time score is available.

one_x_two.acceptance: Each side must have P(abs(relative_bias) > 0.05) <= 0.05. All three sides are required.

asian_handicap_structure.zero_denominator: Report counts and ratio=null; never add a smoothing constant.

power_and_sample_size.anchor: At N=2790 the observed 95% relative-bias interval half-width is approximately 0.055; width scales as 1/sqrt(N).
power_and_sample_size.interpretation: At zero observed bias, the anchored 95% interval is narrow enough to fit inside the +/-0.05 decision boundary. This is not a guarantee of passing and is not adjusted after seeing outcomes.
power_and_sample_size.date_rationale: 3376 / 200 = 16.88 months after 2026-08-30. The date is intentionally distinct from and does not modify the frozen V2 evaluation at 2028-02-01T00:05:00Z.

look_policy.terminal: Look exactly once only when both settled N >= 3376 and UTC time >= 2028-02-02T00:05:00Z.

interim_safety.fault_threshold: absolute relative bias > 0.15 on any of home, draw, or away

look_policy.before_any_allowed_look: B2 outputs counts and blockers only; it must not compute, return, log, or serialize metric values.

immutable_boundaries: No parameter or threshold may be selected from A-track or B-track outcomes.
No Provider calls, production writes, deployment, ledger change, allowlist change, or V2 runtime activation.
The frozen 2028-02-01T00:05:00Z V2 preregistration is untouched.
